models_evaluated: commercially available AI-assisted endoscopic diagnostic support system for early gastric cancer

links.outcome: Local diagnostic performance of AI against pathology reference standard
links.effect: Sensitivity 97.6%, NPV 95.7%, specificity 45.8% on local real-world lesions; false positives remained common.
links.quote: The AI system demonstrated a sensitivity of 97.6% and an NPV of 95.7%, with a specificity of 45.8%.

unlisted_practices: Stratifying AI outputs by repeated-assessment confidence and regional reproducibility to reduce false-positive interpretation
Identifying lesion characteristics (size ≥30 mm, scar, erosion) associated with AI false positives

screen.reason: The study evaluates a commercially available AI endoscopy system in real-world clinical practice and specifically investigates confidence stratification and repeated-assessment thresholding to mitigate false-positive diagnoses.

primary.practice: confidence stratification and repeated evaluation thresholds
